create_joint_instance: create a Joint instance with a name, type, child name, and parent name
set_joint_origin_xyz: set the origin xyz coordinates of a Joint using setOriginXyz with a 3D vector
set_joint_origin_rpy: set the origin roll pitch yaw of a Joint using setOriginRpy with a 3D vector
set_joint_axis: set the rotation axis of a Joint using setAxis with a 3D direction vector
set_joint_limits: set the lower and upper limit values of a Joint using setLimitLower and setLimitUpper
